waves.title: Day Notify-check Contract Probe
waves.goal: Bind existing Day runtime-indicator files, verify whether a Day-owned Notify-check intake/default/dispatch surface exists, and stop with a contract-mismatch verdict if absent.
verification_commands: rg -n --hidden -S "notify check|notify-check|notifyCheck|notify_check|execute=true|execute false" frontend/app frontend/components frontend/lib frontend/e2e
acceptance_criteria: Exact Day runtime-indicator bindings are recorded.
The worker records whether Day Notify-check intake/default/dispatch bindings exist.
If no bindings exist, the packet records contract-mismatch-no-day-notify-surface and does not edit frontend behavior.
Runtime-indicator-only evidence is not misclassified as Notify-check acceptance proof.
deferred_work: Creating a new Day Notify-check frontend surface
Implementing execute=true defaulting after a concrete surface is approved
Adding Day Notify-check Playwright tests after a concrete surface exists

requirements.xml: Add SCN-DAY-NOTIFY-CHECK-CONTRACT-MISMATCH plus a defect, invariant, failure policy, and success criterion that prevent accepting runtime-indicator evidence as Notify-check proof when no concrete Day surface exists.
development-plan.xml: Add FLOW-DAY-NOTIFY-CHECK-CONTRACT-PROBE, a sequencing rule that forbids inferring Notify-check behavior from the Day runtime-indicator disclosure, and PKT-FEAT-NOTIFY-CHECK-CONTRACT-PROBE.
knowledge-graph.xml: Record FEAT-NOTIFY-CHECK slice artifacts, M-FE-DAY-RUNTIME-INDICATOR bindings, missing M-FE-NOTIFY-CHECK-INTAKE-DEFAULTS and M-FE-NOTIFY-CHECK-DISPATCH nodes, and blocked_by_contract_mismatch links.
verification-matrix.md: Add VM-FEAT-NOTIFY-CHECK-CONTRACT-MISMATCH with packet-local evidence ownership and no canonical Today/Week closeout requirement.
